facts.fact: 下山时 Lucan 一路抱着 Micah，不肯放下。
facts.anchor: “I can walk,” he protests for what must be the fifth time.

facts.fact: 两人关系公开化，Lucan 以吻回应嘟嘴。
facts.anchor: I lean down and press a quick kiss to his pouted lips.

facts.fact: Maple 呆在背包里好奇张望。
facts.anchor: Every so often, she lets out a soft chirp.

facts.fact: Lucan 远望 Castor 王的城堡并担心其反应。
facts.anchor: My gaze drifts toward the castle in the distance.

facts.fact: Micah 提议去城外蘑菇场求证。
facts.anchor: mushroom farm just outside Thistle Grove,” he says. “The owner is a very nice fae. Her unicorn was a former patient of mine. We should stop there and ask her about those blue mushrooms the dragons were eating.”

facts.fact: 农场主 Amanita 证实蓝蘑菇非本地野生。
facts.anchor: “I grow them for culinary use. They aren’t native to this region.”

facts.fact: 国王曾整批购买冰盖蘑菇孢子。
facts.anchor: “Actually, the king is particularly fond of them. He bought an entire shipment of spores from me last year.”

facts.fact: Amanita 警告这种蘑菇对龙有毒并致突变。
两人推断有人蓄意在山上种毒蘑菇灭龙。
facts.anchor: Someone planted those mushrooms on Mount Embercrest with one goal in mind—to wipe out every last dragon.
